summary: Flat residential kerb near the bottom, homes roughly 12-18 m away.
reasons: Homes 12-18 m away on same side

best_section.where: East kerb of Furlong Street, 15-30 m up from the bottom junction

drivers.seclusion: Detached homes 10-18 m away on the section's own side, more across the road; no buffer of bush or park.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street; cars park along both sides so there is likely room for a van at the kerb.
drivers.traffic: Quiet local street, a junction just to the south.
drivers.convention: Cars park on the street, though there is no sign of overnight campers.

flags: Steep elsewhere: mean 7.9%, max 19.4%; best section nearly flat
Low-lying: about 7.8 m, Cubberla Creek 164 m away
sun_shade: Mostly open; garden trees near the junction give some afternoon shade from the east side.
